text:
Asha (Head of Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about release cadence, oncall experimentation, quality bars, and SLAs. Dropping a short thread for specific asks.

Devon (VP Eng): Short plan: keep 3-week major cadence for now; allow weekly minor/patch windows. Hotfixes use fast-track with ops sign-off.

Ike (Eng Manager): Teams want a single-sentence rule for "major" vs "minor" to include in PRs. Can we confirm wording?

Rae (SRE): Proposed one-liner: "Major = API contract change, model weight change, or DB migration; everything else is minor." Will add examples to the runbook.

Ike (Eng Manager): On oncall: request to shorten primary from 3w to 2w. Ops worried about churn from handoffs. Any compromise?

Rae (SRE): Compromise: 2w primary + 1w overlap (shadow). Outgoing primary remains available but not first pager. Pilot on runtime + api teams for one quarter and measure handover noise.

Devon (VP Eng): Pilot approved. We'll track pages during overlap, ack times, and post-handoff follow-ups. If noise increases significantly revert.

Asha (Head of Eng): Quality gates: Product wants fewer noisy blocks. What thresholds should block a release vs just warn?

Rae (SRE): Starting thresholds (tunable): block if golden-set relevance drops >4% relative OR hallucination rate increases >5% absolute OR 95p latency regresses >10%. Below that send a warning to model owners.

Ike (Eng Manager): If a release is blocked, what's the SLA for acknowledgement and mitigation? Teams need clarity.

Rae (SRE): Protocol: acknowledge P1 block within 4 business hours; mitigation plan within 24 hours. If unresolved after 48 hours, release lead + product + reliability convene for decision. We'll add this to the runbook.

prod-bot: Reminder: add the short release-ready checklist to PR templates: CI green, smoke tests, rollback plan, docs note. https://redwood.internal/releases/templates

Asha (Head of Eng): Action items: @Rae to PR pilot schedule + overlap checklist by EOW; @Ike to add one-liner wording into PR templates; @Devon will publish pilot metrics to the leadership channel after 1 month. Drop any edge cases here (cross-service migrations, infra-only rollouts). :thumbsup:
